nodes.title: SG-8.4.3 Show 'No suggestions yet this round' for an empty loaded history
nodes.body:
Context: ContributionSheet loads the player's history with listMine and tracks historyStatus ('loading' | 'ready' | 'error'), but renders nothing when the load succeeds with zero entries. Desired behavior: when history loaded successfully and there are no entries, show 'No suggestions yet this round'; hide it as soon as an entry is added. Expected result: the player sees an explicit empty state. Why: an empty list is otherwise indistinguishable from a broken one.

## Acceptance criteria
- Given listMine resolves with an empty list, when the sheet is open, then the text 'No suggestions yet this round' is visible.
- Given the empty message is visible, when the player submits an idea and an entry appears (sending, sent or failed), then the message is no longer in the document.
- Given history is loading or failed to load, then the empty message is not shown.


## Scope
- In scope: Empty-history message in ContributionSheet
- Out of scope: Backend changes
- Out of scope: Loading and error states, which already exist
- Out of scope: Restyling the modal
- Preserve: Existing loading, error, Retry, validation, quota and submit behavior
- Preserve: listMine and submitContribution API contracts


## Technical constraints
- React + TypeScript in game/frontend
- Use the existing historyStatus state and entries list; no new state owner
- No backend or API change


## Definition of done
- Requirement implemented and verified by unit tests
- Existing contribution tests still pass


## Non-functional requirements
- Message exposed to assistive tech via role=status


## Clarifying questions
- None

nodes.title: REQ · Empty loaded history shows 'No suggestions yet this round' and hides once an entry exists
nodes.body:
Context: ContributionSheet.tsx renders the entries list unconditionally and has no empty state. Desired behavior: render a paragraph with the exact text 'No suggestions yet this round' only while historyStatus is 'ready' and entries is empty. Expected result: it appears after an empty successful load and disappears when any entry is added. Why: gives the player clear feedback.

## Acceptance criteria
- Given historyStatus is 'ready' and entries is empty, when rendered, then 'No suggestions yet this round' is shown with role=status.
- Given the message is shown, when a submission adds an entry, then the message is removed.
- Given historyStatus is 'loading' or 'error', when entries is empty, then the message is not rendered.


## Scope
- In scope: Conditional empty message in ContributionSheet
- Out of scope: New API calls
- Preserve: Existing history behavior and messages


## Technical constraints
- Derive from existing state; do not add a new state variable


## Definition of done
- Act and Verify units complete


## Clarifying questions
- None

nodes.summary: Unit tests for showing and hiding the empty history message
nodes.description: Write unit tests from the spec with listMine and submitContribution mocked via vi.mock of ../src/api/client, following tests/contributionHistoryStatus.test.tsx.
acceptance_criteria: Empty ready state shows the message.

technical_constraints: vitest + @testing-library/react with jsdom; all API calls mocked

steps.action: Create the file with '// @vitest-environment jsdom', mock '../src/api/client' via vi.mock(importOriginal) replacing listMine and submitContribution with vi.fn(), reset mocks in beforeEach and cleanup in afterEach, and render <ContributionSheet open onClose={vi.fn()} roundId="round-1" />. Submission responses use contributionFixture from tests/fixtures/api.ts, which mirrors the Contribution type returned by submitContribution in src/api/client.ts.
steps.command: cd game/frontend && npx vitest run tests/contributionHistoryEmpty.test.tsx

steps.symbol: it('shows the empty message when history loads empty')
steps.action: Mock listMine to resolve []; render; assert await screen.findByText('No suggestions yet this round') is truthy.
steps.command: cd game/frontend && npx vitest run tests/contributionHistoryEmpty.test.tsx -t 'shows the empty message'

steps.symbol: it('hides the empty message after an entry is added')
steps.action: Mock listMine to resolve [] and submitContribution to resolve contributionFixture; render, wait for the empty message, type 'A new idea' into the textbox labelled 'Your idea' with userEvent or fireEvent, click Send; assert the message is gone (waitFor queryByText is null) and 'A new idea' is listed.
steps.command: cd game/frontend && npx vitest run tests/contributionHistoryEmpty.test.tsx -t 'hides the empty message'

steps.symbol: it('does not show the empty message while loading or on error')
steps.action: Case 1: listMine returns a never-resolving promise; assert queryByText('No suggestions yet this round') is null. Case 2: listMine rejects; await the alert 'Could not load your suggestions' and assert the empty message is null. Also assert that a non-empty history ([contributionFixture]) does not show it.
steps.command: cd game/frontend && npx vitest run tests/contributionHistoryEmpty.test.tsx
steps.expected: All tests in the file pass.
